observation_method: Re-executed from the pinned v2 archive in an isolated temporary directory; no working-tree imports.

findings.impact: Plain short-vowel forms of the three curated ordinary nouns can be lexical candidates, but the narrow frames declared completeness without a witness discharging their missing tanwin/construction condition. No fact admission was observed.
findings.required_fix: Keep noun candidates and an explicit CONSTRUCT_STATE_OR_TANWIN_EVIDENCE obligation; current finite frames cannot discharge it. This is not a claim that every noun without tanwin is an idafa or is invalid Arabic.

source_basis.inference_limit: The necessity of a witness follows from the deliberately closed pilot, its ordinary-noun classes, and the absence of licensed idafa/waqf/deletion in its three frames. Source statements about idafa are not contraposed into an automatic classifier of every non-tanwin noun.
